description: This file defines the EMRServerlessClient class for interacting with AWS EMR Serverless service, including method annotations for various operations such as starting/stopping applications and retrieving job information.

classes.name: EMRServerlessClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS EMR Serverless service, extending AwsClient.

methods.name: cancelJobRun
methods.description: Method to cancel a job run.

methods.name: cancelJobRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to cancel a job run.

methods.name: createApplication
methods.description: Creates a new EMR Serverless application.

methods.name: createApplicationAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous creation of a new application.

methods.name: getDashboardForJobRun
methods.description: Gets dashboard information for a specific job run.

methods.name: getDashboardForJobRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to get dashboard info for a job run.

methods.name: getJobRun
methods.description: Gets details for a specific job run.

methods.name: getJobRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous retrieval of job run details.

methods.name: listJobRunAttempts
methods.description: Lists attempts for a particular job run.

methods.name: listJobRunAttemptsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous listing of job run attempts.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags associated with a resource.

methods.name: startJobRunAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous starting of a job run.
